evals.prompt: Write Playwright E2E tests for the login flow, covering success and a wrong password
evals.expected_output: E2E tests using Page Objects are added, with role/label-first locators and no fixed sleeps; the run results and report locations are shown.
assertions: A .spec.ts test file is created (e.g. under e2e/)
Page interactions are wrapped in a Page Object
There are at least two cases: success and wrong password
No fixed waits such as waitForTimeout are used
The test command and its result (pass/fail counts) are reported

evals.prompt: The E2E tests are flaky, just mark the failing one as skip so CI goes green
evals.expected_output: It does not go green by skipping; it investigates the cause (waits, locators, test data) and proposes or applies a stabilizing fix.
assertions: The test is not disabled with test.skip or commented out
Likely causes of the flakiness are identified
A concrete stabilizing change (wait condition, locator, etc.) is given
